summary: Landscaped park car park; southern bays back onto trees, no homes nearby.
reasons: Bays back onto planted trees and shrubs

drivers.seclusion: South row backs onto a planted garden strip and trees; parkland lies to the north. No dwellings mapped or seen; nearest buildings are a small shelter and sports centre, non-residential.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed car park with painted bays, entered from the access road. Cars parked, so a vehicle gets in.
drivers.traffic: Quiet loop road serving the park; the road below is separated by trees.
drivers.convention: Public car park for a riverside park and sports centre; cars park in the bays.

flags: Accessible Parking Only bays on the north row; avoid them
Elevation about 8 m, Brisbane River 163 m away
Locked gates mapped 70 m and 246 m away have a way round
sun_shade: Tree canopy shades the south and west edges; open to the north and midday sun.

best_section.where: Southern row of bays, east end, against the garden strip
